name: 29345-decodeonly-16b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of the node, --gres=gpu:1), SM90. Not interchangeable: the serving mode below requires compute capability >= 9.0 and the pinned attention backend is accepted on major == 9 only.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP off. One in-process vLLM engine, one process, no NCCL.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=256, bound max_requests 2560 with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup 10% and cooldown 10%, as declared in `configs/scenario.json`. The warmup excludes by completion and selects by overlap, and under a request-count bound the cooldown boundary lands past the end of the run, so the scored set is not `total - warmup - cooldown`.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt EXACTLY 2 tokens and output EXACTLY 100 (min = max both ways), greedy at temperature 0.0, so every request is the same fixed amount of work: one trivial prefill against 100 sequential decode steps. The backend forces ignore_eos=True whenever max_tokens is set, so all 100 tokens are always generated. Wire length is not declared length: the vllm_python backend renders the prompt into a chat message and applies the chat template, so the engine sees roughly ten prompt tokens rather than two and reports its own count.
purpose: A 16-billion-parameter chat assistant streaming 100-token replies to tiny prompts for 256 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line: commit 70d5953f820ec528e2b6050a7969130009410d1e
# (`v0.11.1-301-g70d5953f820e`), one GPU, in-process through guidellm's `vllm_python` backend.
#
# CAUTION, flat reader: this file is read line by line and any line starting with a space is
# skipped, so every key must be top-level and every value must fit on one line.
#
# Two environment variables are part of this declaration and cannot be written here, because
# neither is an AsyncEngineArgs field: VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 and
# VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND=FLASH_ATTN_MLA. Both live in `configs/tuned.yaml`.

model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-model-len: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# Pinned, not tuned: built through AsyncLLMEngine.from_engine_args, whose usage context is absent
# from this commit's per-context default table, an unpinned run falls through to class defaults of
# 2048 / 128 -- and max_num_seqs 128 would silently cap a 256-stream workload at half its
# declared concurrency.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

enable-chunked-prefill: true
